answers.sql: SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN definition='all_eligible_events' THEN transfer_volume ELSE NULL END) - MAX(CASE WHEN definition='largest_eligible_per_tx' THEN transfer_volume ELSE NULL END)) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN definition='largest_eligible_per_tx' THEN transfer_volume ELSE NULL END) AS value FROM exports

SELECT (COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period='P2' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn')),0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period='P1' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn')),0)) * 100.0 / COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_units) FROM events WHERE period='P1' AND event_kind NOT IN ('mint','burn')),0) AS value
